records.reuseInstructions: Rollei's current product FAQ states that developers are sensitive to oxidation and lose activity with reuse; fresh working solution is generally the more reliable choice. No Supergrain-specific replenishment procedure is published in the manufacturer data sheet.
records.shelfLifeUnopened: Rollei's current chemistry FAQ on the Supergrain product page gives general manufacturer guidance: unopened concentrates usually keep about 1–2 years when stored cool and dark. This is general Rollei chemistry guidance, not a Supergrain-specific guaranteed shelf-life figure.
records.storageNotes: Store airtight, cool and away from light; minimize air exposure after opening. The Supergrain manufacturer data sheet documents 1+9, 1+12 and 1+15 working dilutions.
records.sourceTitle: Rollei Supergrain product page and official SUPERGRAIN data sheet
